nodes.label: Main bootstrap
nodes.desc: 121-line entry script of the browser process: uncaughtException dialog, process.exit override, IPC wiring, ESM/CJS dispatch.

nodes.label: Renderer bootstrap
nodes.desc: Preload-side init: Module.wrapper patch to preserve process/global, vm module warning, memory info via IPC.

nodes.label: Common bootstrap
nodes.desc: Timers/util imports plus wrapWithActivateUvLoop so setImmediate wakes the loop in short-lived processes.

nodes.label: Main module registry
nodes.desc: Alphabetical lazy-loader list of 40 browser-side modules, mixing TS requires and process._linkedBinding entries.

nodes.label: app API
nodes.desc: TS augmentation of the native app binding: app path handling, quit choreography, packaged-app events.

nodes.label: BaseWindow API
nodes.desc: TS wrapper over the native BaseWindow class; shared windowing logic for BrowserWindow.

nodes.label: BrowserWindow shim
nodes.desc: 233-line prototype patch: frozen id, focus/blur forwarding to app, unresponsive timer, loadURL/send wrappers.

nodes.label: webContents shim
nodes.desc: Wraps the electron_browser_web_contents native binding; registry of all live renderers.

nodes.label: session API
nodes.desc: Per-partition session API: cookies, cache, permission handlers, protocol registration.

nodes.label: net API
nodes.desc: Chromium network stack exposed as a Node-like HTTP client API.

nodes.label: ipcRenderer re-export
nodes.desc: Single require of the electron_renderer_ipc binding's ipcRenderer object.

nodes.label: contextBridge re-export
nodes.desc: Re-export of the electron_renderer_context_bridge binding.

nodes.label: webFrame API
nodes.desc: Frame-level controls: zoom, spellcheck, insertCSS, executeJavaScript.

nodes.label: guest-view channels
nodes.desc: Listens on ipcRendererInternal for GUEST_VIEW_INTERNAL_DISPATCH_EVENT and invokes guest lifecycle channels.

nodes.label: Channel enum
nodes.desc: const enum IPC_MESSAGES with 9 reserved channel names shared by main and renderer.

nodes.label: nativeImage API
nodes.desc: Image wrapper usable in both processes; backed by the common electron_api_native_image.cc binding.

nodes.label: shell API
nodes.desc: openExternal/openPath wrappers available in main and renderer.

nodes.label: IPC dispatch hookup
nodes.desc: 7 lines: hands ipcMain/ipcMainInternal to the native electron_browser_ipc_dispatch binding.

nodes.label: IpcMainImpl class
nodes.desc: EventEmitter subclass with a Map of invoke handlers; handle() rejects duplicates, handleOnce() auto-removes.

nodes.label: ipcMainInternal
nodes.desc: One-line export: a second IpcMainImpl instance for Electron-internal traffic.

nodes.label: ipcRendererInternal
nodes.desc: One-line export of the internal emitter from the electron_renderer_ipc binding.

nodes.label: rpc-server
nodes.desc: Serves remote procedure calls coming from webContents and devtools.

nodes.label: guest-view manager
nodes.desc: Main-side owner of webview guests; dispatches events to embedders via GUEST_VIEW_INTERNAL_DISPATCH_EVENT.

nodes.label: ElectronApiIPC contract
nodes.desc: 128-line mojom: ElectronApiIPC Message/Invoke/[Sync] MessageSync, ElectronRenderer, ElectronFrame, SerializedValue with BigBuffer.

nodes.label: Native ipcRenderer
nodes.desc: 534 lines: IPCBase gin wrappable, IPCRenderFrame vs IPCServiceWorker transports, emitter factory with kTransport/kInternal fields.

nodes.label: Frame handler
nodes.desc: 196-line mojo receiver per RenderFrameHost; guards WebContents lifetime and always replies to pending invokes.

nodes.label: Dispatch bridge
nodes.desc: IsReady gate plus Message/Invoke/PostMessage/MessageHost shims onto the JS emitters.

nodes.label: IpcMainEvent
nodes.desc: gin::Wrappable event object handed to ipcMain listeners; carries sender frame and reply callback.

nodes.label: context-bridge impl
nodes.desc: Cross-world object proxying with an object cache under shell/renderer/api/context_bridge/.

nodes.label: BrowserClient glue
nodes.desc: 2459-line content::ContentBrowserClient override; registers the ElectronApiIPC binder for every render frame.

nodes.label: gin Wrappable base
nodes.desc: Base class binding C++ objects to V8 wrappers with pointer-tag safety.

nodes.label: Node EventEmitter kit
nodes.desc: Builds native objects that emit through Node's EventEmitter prototype (used for ipcRenderer).

nodes.label: V8 serializer
nodes.desc: SerializeV8Value/DeserializeV8Value using Blink's V8 value serializer; powers every IPC payload.
